evals.prompt: 给『产品周会』群发一条消息，内容是本周发布清单（三条要点，带标题）。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Find the chat_id with +chat-search, then send a --markdown message with +messages-send.
expectations: Resolves the group's chat_id with +chat-search instead of guessing it

evals.prompt: Find the messages from last week where someone mentioned "invoice" in any chat I am in. List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Search across chats with +messages-search using the keyword and a time range.
expectations: Uses im +messages-search with the keyword invoice
Restricts the search to last week's time range
Uses user identity because it searches the user's own chats

evals.prompt: 回复消息 om_abc123，在它的话题里说『已修复，请复测』。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Reply with +messages-reply --reply-in-thread to the given message id.
expectations: Adds --reply-in-thread so the reply appears in the thread

evals.prompt: Download the PDF attachment from message om_file789 in chat oc_team42. List the lark-cli commands you would run in order (placeholders are fine) and what each step is for.
evals.expected_output: Download with +messages-resources-download using the message id and file key.
expectations: Gets the file key from the message (for example with +messages-mget) before downloading

evals.prompt: 把飞书文档 https://example.feishu.cn/docx/DocIm001 的内容原样发到群 oc_ops01。列出你会按顺序执行的 lark-cli 命令（参数用占位符即可），并说明每一步的目的。
evals.expected_output: Fetch the document with --doc-format im-markdown and send the fetched text unchanged with --markdown.
expectations: Fetches the document with docs +fetch --doc-format im-markdown
Sends the fetched content unchanged with +messages-send --markdown to oc_ops01
Keeps user cite tags in the content instead of stripping them
